rule.description: A production function signature carries the module's per-column MAX, MEAN and MIN tail aggregate arrays as three separate pointer-to-double parameters (or double[] parameters of a max*-, mean*- and min*-named member family), so the cohesive aggregate group recurs parameter-by-parameter across production responsibilities instead of being owned and passed as one abstraction. The rule fires on a function definition only when all three aggregate heads appear in one parameter list. plain-C code has no classes, so locations are file/function pairs.

checks.description: Detect functions whose definitions accept the per-column MAX/MEAN/MIN tail aggregate group as separate pointer-to-double parameters.
checks.detected_relation: function signature -> recurring (max, mean, min) per-column aggregate pointer triple
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The three aggregate arrays are one cohesive per-column group owned by the module record; a signature that lists them member-by-member forces every related function and call site to repeat the same grouping by hand, indicating missing encapsulation instead of an owner-based abstraction.

matches.evidence: static void tail_init_col(double *max_array, double *mean_array, double *min_array, double st_val, int k) threads the whole aggregate triple to seed one column.
static void tail_track_extremes(double *max_buf, double *mean_buf, double *min_buf, double new_val, int idx) threads the same triple under a second parameter-name family to update running extremes.
static void tail_update_mean(double *max_array, double *mean_array, double *min_array, double st_val, int k, long n_record) threads the full triple although only the mean member is written.
static double *pick_tail_array(double *max_array, double *mean_array, double *min_array, int tail_type) threads the triple to return the one aggregate an output section reads.

excluded.candidate: module callback signature (struct module *, double st_array[], U_64 pre_array[], U_64 cur_array[], int)
excluded.reason: published plugin interface shared with every dlopen'ed module; a fixed ABI, not a recurring design grouping, and st_array/pre_array/cur_array are not the max/mean/min per-column aggregate triple
a two-member group of a different element type (U_64) used by subtract statistics; not the tail aggregate group and not threaded as a recurring triple
addresses the max/mean/min arrays through the owning struct module record, which is already the owner-passing form the shared rule asks for
